issues.reason: Status predicates states that a prohibition is the denial of permission — (Permitted e) at strength 0.0, "not a negated (Obligated e)" — so the emitted bundle records only the (mis-scoped) denial of an obligation the text never raises instead of the advised-against tempering.

The lost "should" force is real (the parse is indistinguishable from "must not be tempered"), but it is a coverage gap rather than a repairable defect: in a negated deontic the strength slot is occupied by the polarity (0.0) and the instruction set defines no weak-prohibition carrier, and inventing one is barred.

gaps_confirmed: negated weak deontic "should not / ought not" — the prohibition rule names only must not / may not / shall not / forbidden, and once the bundle strength is 0.0 the 0.7 "should" force has no carrier left
repair_summary: Replaced (Obligated sk_temper_1) with (Permitted sk_temper_1) inside the strength-0 bundle so the atom denies permission, the instruction set's prohibition form, rather than denying an obligation.
notes: Everything else stands: the demonstrative definite "this steel" rightly projects its typing atom outside the denial, the agentless passive omits the Agent, and a treatment verb takes Patient.
